title: Write the heartbeat and fallback proposals for the producers and NERV
goal: Each repository that moves gets a numbered proposal for the heartbeat, ready for the owner to decide
acceptance: One numbered proposal each for grover, fpvbuddy and nerv (the acknowledgement or read marker NERV records and exposes, nerv proposal 1 of the report being the watcher-of-the-watcher record), each naming the record or step to create there (title, one-line Issue, Check), added to the F-018-T02 proposals page
Nothing is edited in a component from this repository
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: The report's "per producer" remainder; the same shape as F-018-T02. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
